properties.title: Gray's Reef National Marine Sanctuary — CRW_SST (dhw_5km) daily area series
properties.description: Daily statistics of sea surface temperature over the Gray's Reef National Marine Sanctuary (NMS:GRNMS) polygon from the rasters collection, 1985-01-01 to 2026-10-04: area-weighted mean (cell coverage fraction), unweighted mean, sd, min, max, n_cells, plus the climate-dashboard-app's own mean for comparison.

data.title: CRW_SST daily area series for Gray's Reef National Marine Sanctuary

table:columns.name: mean
table:columns.description: area-weighted mean over the place polygon: each 0.05 deg cell weighted by the fraction of it inside the polygon (as terra::zonal(exact=TRUE) and the app's mean_wt)

table:columns.name: mean_unwt
table:columns.description: unweighted mean over the cells that touch the polygon

table:columns.name: sd
table:columns.description: sample standard deviation over those cells (unweighted)

table:columns.name: n_cells
table:columns.description: cells with a value that touch the polygon

table:columns.name: weight_sum
table:columns.description: sum of the coverage weights of those cells (cell-equivalents of polygon area)

table:columns.name: mean_shiny
table:columns.description: the climate-dashboard-app's own daily mean (its CSV; terra::zonal(exact=TRUE) over its sanctuary polygon), for comparison
